subject: Implementation timeline & legal sync for Northlight MSA
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex.green@northlight.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@northlight.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Implementation timeline & legal sync for Northlight MSA

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looks promising. Our legal and procurement teams did a quick pass on the MSA and attached a marked-up version with a few redlines and questions (Northlight_MSA_redline_v1.docx). To keep our implementation timeline intact we need a short redline review call to: 

- Walk through substantive changes (data residency, retention, and audit logs)
- Agree on any carve-outs or open items that block signature
- Confirm who will drive final sign-off and the handoff to implementation

Do any of these slots work for your side?

• Wed Nov 3, 10:00–10:30 PT
• Wed Nov 3, 14:00–14:30 PT
• Thu Nov 4, 09:00–09:30 PT

If none, let us know alternatives. Attendees from our side will be Samantha Liu (legal) and myself (procurement). I can share the redline now — attached.

Cheers,
Alex Green
Head of Procurement
Northlight Analytics

Attachment: Northlight_MSA_redline_v1.docx

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@northlight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Implementation timeline & legal sync for Northlight MSA

Alex — thanks for sending this over and for the clear agenda. We want to be responsive here; 

Quick notes from our side:
- We can cover data residency and audit logging concerns in a 30-minute slot if both legal reps are present.
- Ben will run point on the technical answers (KV cache / retention settings) and Marissa will cover contract language and fallbacks.

From the slots you proposed, the 14:00 PT window on Nov 3 is the best for our team. If that works for you we will:
1) Send a calendar invite with a concise agenda and a Zoom link
2) Share our vendor-onboarding checklist before the call (quick pre-read)

Please confirm the 14:00 PT slot. I attached our onboarding checklist for reference — it has the timeline and sign-off owners.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx

From: Alex Green <alex.green@northlight.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>
Cc: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@northlight.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@northlight.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Implementation timeline & legal sync for Northlight MSA

Logan — appreciate the quick reply. 14:00 PT on Nov 3 is tight for our legal team — they asked whether we could push to 16:00 PT the same day so Samantha can join after an internal review. If 16:00 PT works we’ll confirm right away.

Quoted for context:
> On Tue, Nov 2, 2027 at 11:02 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference> wrote:
> > From the slots you proposed, the 14:00 PT window on Nov 3 is the best for our team.

Apologies for the short notice — internal timing shifted on our end. Otherwise we can do Thu Nov 4 at 09:00 PT.

Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@northlight.ai>, Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@northlight.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 4 Nov 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Confirmed: Northlight MSA redline review — Nov 3 16:00 PT (rescheduled)

Thanks Alex — 16:00 PT on Nov 3 works for us. I’ve booked the call and included a short agenda and pre-reads. Please confirm Samantha and any additional attendees.

Meeting details:
- When: Wed Nov 3, 2027 — 16:00–16:30 PT
- Where: Zoom (link in calendar invite) — https://zoom.us/j/123456789
- Agenda (15 mins review + 10 mins open items + 5 mins next steps):
  • Data residency & retention language (Samantha + Marissa)
  • Audit logs / access controls (Ben)
  • Rollout timeline and sign-off owner (Logan)

Action items before the call:
- Alex: confirm your legal attendees and highlight any clauses you want prioritized (we saw redlines on section 4 and 9)
- Samantha: if you can flag open language or proposed alternative wording ahead of time that will make the call more efficient
- Logan/Ben/Marissa: we will upload our suggested language snippets into the shared Drive folder and paste any DocuSign next steps if agreed on the call.

Link to pre-reads: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cd_example
DocuSign (placeholder for signatures post-agreement): https://www.docusign.net/link/DocuSignEnvelope123456

If anything changes, please reply-all so the calendar invite can be updated. Looking forward to the sync.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
